messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — ACME FinServ needs alignment on the pilot acceptance criteria and any enterprise blockers. They want a 4 week pilot, end-to-end eval, and a security questionnaire completed. @aj-ps can you propose concrete KPIs?

aj-ps: Sounds good. Proposed success criteria: p95 latency <= 350ms for 1-2 turn chat (hosted endpoint), avg cost <= $0.015 / 1k tokens for the expected workload, and quality: >= 92% intent accuracy on the curated prompt set of ~120 prompts. Also: regression tolerance <= 2% vs baseline.

sam-engineering: Couple of notes: 350ms p95 is realistic on our rdx-2b in hosted when seq len < 512 and KV cache hits are high. For worst-case long-contexts (2k tokens) expect p95 to spike — propose a fallback plan: route long-context queries to a lower-cost batch path or lower-precision quantized model.

lee-security: We need ACME to return the security questionnaire before we can enable Dedicated or any private deployment. Key asks from our side: data residency requirement, KMS/HSM usage, audit log retention, and allowed 3rd-party integrations. I'll paste the questionnaire link: https://confluence.redwood.local/security/pilot-sq 

jordan-customer: Quick clarifications from ACME: (1) latency target can be relaxed to p95 <= 500ms for up to 1k token context if that helps; (2) cost target they quoted internally is <= $0.02 / 1k tokens; (3) quality is non-negotiable — they'll run blind human evals and expect >= 90% pass on acceptance prompts.

aj-ps: OK noted. Updated acceptance thresholds: latency p95 <= 500ms (1k ctx), cost <= $0.02 / 1k tokens, quality >= 90% human pass + automated intent accuracy >= 92% on the dev prompt set. We'll run both automated and blinded human evals.

maria-sales: Good. Timeline: week 0 — questionnaire + account setup; week 1 — model selection & baseline run; week 2 — prompt tuning & eval harness; week 3 — blind human eval + perf testing; week 4 — final review & acceptance. Can owners confirm?

sam-engineering: I'll own perf testing and model config. Action items: provide recommended model/quantization by EOD tomorrow, and a short runbook for traffic shaping and cache warmup. Example eval command we'll use:

```
# run intent accuracy on pilot set
redwood eval run --model rdx-2b-quant --prompt-set acme_pilot_prompts.json --metrics intent_accuracy,latency_p95 --out results/acme_week1.json
```

lee-security: I'll send the SQ and an RSA-signed NDA template to ACME today. Also need to know if they require on-prem. If yes, lead time for Private deploy is ~6 weeks.

jordan-customer: ACME will fill the SQ by Thu and prefers hosted for pilot. They also want a simple SLA for demo week.

maria-sales: Great — final gating checklist: 1) SQ returned, 2) NDA signed, 3) pilot creds & example traffic, 4) baseline run results (automated), 5) human eval pass rate >= threshold. If any item fails, we do remediation window (1 week) or stop.

aj-ps: I'll prepare the eval prompt pack and the A/B test config (canary traffic split 10/90). Also recommend a small set of regression prompts to watch.

deploy-bot: Demo slot reserved: 2025-06-12 16:00 PT — reminder will be posted 48h prior. :calendar:

maria-sales: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into a single doc and share with ACME. Assigning owners: @lee-security (SQ/NDA), @sam-engineering (perf & runbook), @aj-ps (eval + prompts), me for customer coordination. Any objections?

sam-engineering: No objections. Will start infra prep tomorrow.

lee-security: No objections. Will ping legal on NDA.

jordan-customer: ACME confirms timeline. Thanks! :thumbsup:
